title: Persist denials and block equivalent actions across retries
narrative: Denied intents and side-effect classes must survive graph retries and delegated paths. A denied send cannot be retried through a second provider or tool without new explicit authorization. Native deny/allow paths: `fangore_tool_gating`, `fangore_jev_action_safety`. Tracks MH-DOTS-05[^insp-dots-05].
implementation: Denials today are ephemeral AccessControl / Verdict outcomes. Desired: durable denial memory and equivalent-action detection across turns and tools.
validation: Kind `inspiration_delta_contract`. Soft expects requirement_id MH-DOTS-05, coverage gap, adjacent_ok, probes_ok with typed surface probes encoding the current product delta.
